historical_import_and_entry: one isolated import, writer and fresh cold runner using res://tests/hvn_l1_active_close.gd; unchanged inherited receipt/save, no new engine invocation in this package
paired_capture_hook: only in a future detached copy: hvn_l1_active_close.gd tick(), immediately after await super.tick(1), before closing_index filter, cast the immutable readback for both actual gates and their receipt. The SceneTree physics_frame is pre-process for the current engine count; state belongs to the last completed gate tick. Record raw native engine counter and original route tick, named explicitly without subtracting or relabeling the stock counter.
phase_hooks: Bind writer/cold epoch after scene construction and validated profile/receipt policy; seed prepay and cold reset, never pair across them. Existing _one_close starts selected actual gate via normal E and safe stance. Bind same actual Node instance and gate ID across both samples; never treat frame_post_draw, E request, image midpoint, first paid enable, or cold-settled state as closure.
expected_positive_geometry: After exact writer-context binding, adjacent monotonic same-gate samples must show accepted open target, physical full-open travel and endpoint, then accepted close target and adjacent positive -> zero. Previous >0 and at most 2.3/60 + 1e-6 rad; both earned and active, current unheld. A carried scalar or boolean is not an accepted transition.
requirements_before_any_native_use: Independent inspection of paired readback and instance IDs, exact current source bytes, positive two-gate nonduplicate and negatives, monotonic real physics trace, original 57+11+10 and byte-exact cold profile. No events could be recovered by inventing the missing previous angle from the old midpoint/endpoint images.
stream_custody: Bind original instance->gate map and scene epoch at scene setup, fixed engine minus route phase offset from independently observed writer seed, not from submitted pairs. Compare both clocks with per-gate high water, require full exact overlapping consecutive rows; gap or contradictory overlapping row invalidates the gate epoch. Start from closed baseline and never attach mid-cycle. No unverified caller can send native events.
